description: Listado de Sistemas de Agua Potable Rural en Chile is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Obras Públicas. Los Sistemas de Agua Potable Rural son desarrollados por el Ministerio de Obras Públicas contribuyendo en la ampliación del acceso al agua potable por parte de la ciudadanía, abarcando las localidades rurales semiconcentradas a lo largo de todo el país. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Obras Públicas. Its tags are Agua Potable Rural, abastecimiento de agua potable, agua potable, comunidad, zonas rurales. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2021-08-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
